paragraphs: An E. coli O26 outbreak linked to raw milk cheese has sickened 13 people with 8 hospitalizations across 9 states [1]. A Salmonella outbreak connected to broccoli sprouts has caused 32 illnesses and 3 hospitalizations in 6 states [2]. Sierra Nevada Cheese Company is voluntarily recalling all Graziers Raw Milk Cheese due to potential contamination with E. coli O26:H11 [7].

Sempio Food Services Inc. is recalling Sempio Korean Ginseng Chicken Stew Classic in 31.75-oz pouches sold in Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, and Virginia due to import violations [3]. Fontanini Foods LLC is recalling 10-lb. boxes of Fontanini Pork Sausage Links (Item 393, packed on 06/23/2026) sold in California, Florida, Michigan, and Nevada because of possible foreign matter contamination [4].

Other recalls include Mezzetta Golden Greek Peperoncini Medium Heat (32-ounce) due to a pest contaminant [8], Deano's Pasta Pear and Pecorino Triangoli Ravioli due to undeclared lobster [9], and Lior Cinnamon Ground Seasoning due to elevated lead levels [10]. The CDC has declared the Salmonella outbreak from backyard poultry flocks over, with 1,253 people infected [16].
